He was a disciple of Advaita Ācārya Prabhu. (CC. 1.8.70)

Not the Śivānanda Cakravartī of Gadādhara Paṇḍita's branch who lived in Vṛndāvana (Lavaṅga-mañjarī, Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 183): the two were in this record until 13-11-2026; he has a record of his own, «Śivānanda Cakravartī (Gadādhara's branch)».

He belonged to the branch (śākhā) of Gadādhara Paṇḍita and lived in Vṛndāvana: «śivānanda-cakravartī kṛta-vṛndāvana-sthitiḥ» (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 183).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: a manifestation of Lavaṅga-mañjarī (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 183, Sakhānirṇayāmṛta 20).

Taken out of the record #1425 Śivānanda Cakravartī, disciple of Advaita Ācārya, which mixed the two (13-11-2026).
